name: Penny Varnish
preparty_markdown:
Penny collects small paintings, strange decorative objects, and stories about who owned them before she did.

She is wealthy enough to ignore trends and old enough to enjoy doing so publicly. Penny has a habit of

wandering away from tours and returning with better information than the guide provided.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Eccentric, charming, nosy, unexpectedly shrewd. Ask questions that sound casual and are not.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Old friend of Beatrice Plinth.

• Knows Conrad Gavel from decades of auctions.

• Daphne Palette alternates between finding Penny inspiring and alarming.

COSTUME

Eclectic formalwear: vintage jewelry, dramatic brooches, velvet, patterned jacket, gloves, small opera glasses or fan.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“If everyone agrees it is tasteful, I lose interest.”

“I have never snooped. I have merely arrived before the door closed.”

name: Leo Taggart
preparty_markdown:
Leo knows which gallery used to be a bank, which donor funded which wing, and which local art feud is still

alive despite everyone involved pretending otherwise. His column is affectionate, gossipy, and read by exactly

the people who claim they never read it.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Friendly, curious, locally knowledgeable, a little nosy. You connect people and remember old stories.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Has profiled Adrian Vellum and Beatrice Plinth.

• Friendly with Maya Bell and Avery Lens.

• Nadia Quill considers Leo useful when she needs Tulsa context and dangerous when he starts telling stories.

COSTUME

Cocktail suit or blazer, vintage Tulsa flair if desired, notebook, press card prop, old museum brochure tucked into pocket.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“In Tulsa, every institution has a history and at least one person who remembers it differently.”

“That story is off the record unless it gets better.”

name: Riley Bloom
preparty_markdown:
Riley creates the visual spectacle around events like tonight: flowers, lighting, table styling, entrances,

reveals, and the precise moment everyone is supposed to gasp. They are exuberant, fast-moving, and

convinced that restraint is wonderful when somebody else is responsible for it.

HOW TO PLAY THEM

Energetic, aesthetic, affectionate, slightly chaotic but highly competent. You notice atmosphere first.

WHAT YOU ALREADY KNOW

• Works constantly with Lucian Gable, who removes half of Riley's ideas.

• Felix Savoy is Riley's favorite partner in event logistics.

• Margot Ledger is the person who asks what Riley's ideas cost.

COSTUME

Creative formalwear: floral pin, velvet jacket, unusual bow tie, colorful suit, statement glasses. Optional ribbon swatches or

mini lighting plan.

OPTIONAL QUIPS

“Subtlety is beautiful. We are not using it tonight.”

“The flowers are not excessive. The ceiling is undercommitted.”

Do not invent private history with Sterling Voss before game night. Your sealed party-night packet will reveal what your character actually knows

about him.
